title: Caring for Our Planet
text:
Many people now try to protect the environment. They recycle paper, plastic and glass. Some families also use bags made of cloth when they go shopping.

Trees are very important for our planet. They give us clean air and homes for animals. In many cities, people plant new trees every spring.

questions.text: Why might some families use cloth bags?
options: They want to buy more things
They want to help the environment

questions.text: What can we guess about people who plant trees every spring?

vocabulary.definition: to use old materials again to make new things
to keep something safe from harm
the large world on which we live
living creatures that are not people or plants

paragraph_translations: Багато людей зараз намагаються захищати навколишнє середовище. Вони переробляють папір, пластик і скло. Деякі родини також беруть із собою на покупки сумки з тканини.
Дерева дуже важливі для нашої планети. Вони дають нам чисте повітря і домівки для тварин. У багатьох містах люди щовесни садять нові дерева.
